cues.headline: GOAL! Lio Everly!
cues.body: Harbor City score! It's Elmstead Wanderers 0–1 Harbor City.

cues.headline: Bram Isard scores!
cues.body: Get in! Elmstead Wanderers 0–2 Harbor City.

cues.headline: Rapid!
cues.body: Ivo Esterby just flew past at 25 km/h, the fastest of the match.

cues.headline: Nobody's in charge now
cues.body: The game has settled. Ball over the last 5 minutes: Elmstead Wanderers 65%, Harbor City 35%. Neither team on top.

cues.headline: Elmstead Wanderers have taken over
cues.body: The game is going Elmstead Wanderers's way: recovering the ball 3 times in the final third, winning it straight back 2 times after losing it and winning the ball back in the opposition half 4 times in the last 5 minutes. Just what Elmstead Wanderers need while they're behind.

cues.headline: It's in! Rafe Sallow!
cues.body: Rafe Sallow finds the net for Elmstead Wanderers: Elmstead Wanderers 1–2 Harbor City. It had been coming: Elmstead Wanderers were in control. A long ball over the press set it up.

cues.headline: GOAL! Rafe Sallow!
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers score! It's Elmstead Wanderers 2–2 Harbor City. It had been coming: Elmstead Wanderers were in control.

cues.headline: End to end now!
cues.body: Nobody can keep the ball: it's changing hands 5.8 times a minute. Anything can happen.

cues.headline: Emil Falkner scores!
cues.body: Get in! Elmstead Wanderers 3–2 Harbor City. Against the run of play: Harbor City were in control.

cues.headline: Elmstead Wanderers are on top
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers are on top: forcing Harbor City into 3 losses in their own half, winning the ball back in the opposition half 2 times and playing 10 progressive passes in the last 5 minutes. Elmstead Wanderers are already ahead, and still pushing.

cues.headline: All square out there
cues.body: It's even again: over the last 5 minutes Elmstead Wanderers have had the ball 40% of the time, Harbor City 60%.

cues.headline: It's in! Niko Falkner!
cues.body: Niko Falkner finds the net for Harbor City: Elmstead Wanderers 3–3 Harbor City.

cues.headline: GOAL! Ivo Esterby!
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers score! It's Elmstead Wanderers 4–3 Harbor City. It came 15 seconds after Elmstead Wanderers won the ball high up the pitch.

cues.headline: Nobody's in charge now
cues.body: The game has settled. Ball over the last 5 minutes: Elmstead Wanderers 42%, Harbor City 58%. Neither team on top.

cues.headline: Bram Isard scores!
cues.body: Get in! Elmstead Wanderers 4–4 Harbor City.

cues.headline: It's in! Niko Falkner!
cues.body: Niko Falkner finds the net for Harbor City: Elmstead Wanderers 4–5 Harbor City. It came 18 seconds after Harbor City won the ball high up the pitch.

recap.headline: Full time: Elmstead Wanderers 4–5 Harbor City
recap.summary: A deserved win for Harbor City.
